Jera — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᛃ
harvest results patience pays off natural timing

Upright meaning

Jera is basically the universe telling you: the effort you've put in is paying off. If you've been working steadily at something — and it's felt like a long slog with not much visible reward — this rune is a strong sign that the results are on their way.

You can't rush this. Good things take the time they take. But the key point is that what you've invested isn't wasted — it's building toward something real.

Celebrate what's coming. And once you've enjoyed it, start thinking about what comes next. The harvest is great, but the cycle keeps going — rest, then plant again.
